name: CultDevOps Xml Sitemap Generator: Seo, News, Video, Images, E-Commerce, Ads & Price Comparison
author: cultdevops

sections.description:
CultDevOps Xml Sitemap Generator is a powerful WordPress SEO plugin that helps you create search engine optimized sitemaps for maximum visibility and ranking potential. Whether you’re running a blog, e-commerce store, or working with various advertising and price comparison platforms, this plugin has you covered.

Key Features

  • Multiple Sitemap Types: Generate sitemaps for general content, e-commerce, price comparison sites, and advertising platforms
  • Dynamic & Static Generation: Choose between real-time dynamic sitemaps or static file generation
  • Multiple Formats: Export sitemaps in XML or CSV formats
  • Mobile-First Design: Responsive interface optimized for all devices
  • Bootstrap Integration: Modern, clean interface with Font Awesome icons
  • SEO Optimized: Generate XML sitemaps that search engines love
  • Easy Management: View, manage, and delete generated sitemaps from a central dashboard

Sitemap Categories

General Sitemaps
* Posts
* Pages
* Categories
* Tags
* Media
* Videos
* News
* Custom Taxonomies

E-Commerce Sitemaps
* Product listings optimized for major marketplaces
* Category-based product organization
* Dynamic inventory updates

Price Comparison Sitemaps
* Optimized for global price comparison platforms
* Product price tracking
* Competitive analysis support

Advertising Platform Sitemaps
* Google Ads compatible formats
* Facebook Marketplace optimization
* Multi-platform advertising support

Technical Features

  • PHP 5.6 – 8.3 Compatibility: Works with all modern PHP versions
  • AJAX-Powered: Smooth, fast sitemap generation without page reloads
  • Custom Post Types: Dedicated database structure for sitemap management
  • Rewrite Rules: SEO-friendly URLs for dynamic sitemaps
  • Security: Nonce verification and capability checks
  • Multilingual Ready: Translation-ready with text domain support

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 5.6 or higher (tested up to PHP 8.3)
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher
  • Modern web browser with JavaScript enabled

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support forum or contact us through our website.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data from your website visitors. All sitemap generation is performed locally on your server.

Credits

  • Bootstrap CSS Framework
  • Font Awesome Icons
  • jQuery for AJAX functionality
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sitemap-master directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Sitemap Master menu in your WordPress admin to configure and generate sitemaps
  4. Access the plugin from the admin menu: Sitemap Master
sections.faq:
What types of sitemaps can I generate?

You can generate four main types of sitemaps:
– General content sitemaps (posts, pages, categories, etc.)
– E-commerce sitemaps for marketplace optimization
– Price comparison platform sitemaps
– Advertising platform sitemaps

What’s the difference between dynamic and static sitemaps?

Dynamic sitemaps are generated in real-time when accessed, always showing the latest content. Static sitemaps are generated once and saved as files, which can be faster to load but need manual regeneration when content changes.

Can I export sitemaps in different formats?

Yes, you can export sitemaps in both XML (standard for search engines) and CSV (for data analysis) formats.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin uses a mobile-first responsive design with Bootstrap framework, ensuring it works perfectly on all devices.

How do I access my generated sitemaps?

Generated sitemaps can be accessed through:
– The “Sitemaps” submenu in the plugin admin area
– Direct URLs following the pattern: yoursite.com/[type]-[filename].xml
– The uploads directory for static sitemaps

Does this work with multisite?

Currently, the plugin is designed for single-site installations. Multisite support may be added in future versions.
